nodes.summary: The labeling `x` (with root state `s`) agrees with the observed states `σ` at every leaf.
nodes.title: Labeling agrees with the observed leaf states

nodes.summary: The cost semiring: `MinTropical (WithTop ℕ)`, with `min` as addition and `+` as multiplication.
nodes.title: Min-plus cost semiring

nodes.summary: The total substitution cost of a labeling `x` of the non-root vertices of `t` with root state `s`: the sum over all edges of the cost `untrop (P a b)` from the parent's state `a` to the child's state `b`.
nodes.title: Total substitution cost of a labeling

nodes.summary: Sankoff's cost is attained: if it is finite, some labeling that agrees with the leaf states has exactly this cost. (It is `⊤` exactly when every agreeing labeling uses a forbidden change, or when `t` is a single leaf whose observed state is not `s`.)
nodes.title: Sankoff's cost is attained

nodes.summary: On a binary tree with unit costs, Fitch's count equals the minimum, over root states, of Sankoff's cost.
nodes.title: Fitch's algorithm computes the small-parsimony score

nodes.summary: On a binary tree with unit costs, a root state is in Fitch's set if and only if Sankoff's cost at that state is the minimum.
nodes.title: Fitch's root set is the set of optimal root states

nodes.summary: The set of candidate states at the root of the subtree and the number of changes counted so far. The edge weights of the tree are ignored. Each child is evaluated once per node, so the recursion makes one call per vertex.
nodes.title: Fitch's algorithm

nodes.summary: Every edge of the tree carries the unit cost.
nodes.title: Tree with unit costs on every edge

nodes.summary: The leaf weights of the observed states `σ`: the tropical one (cost `0`) at the observed state and the tropical zero (cost `⊤`) at every other state.
nodes.title: Tropical leaf weights of observed states

nodes.summary: `sankoff σ t s` is the minimum total edge cost over all labelings of the non-root vertices that agree with the observed states at the leaves (with root state `s`).
nodes.title: Sankoff's algorithm computes the small-parsimony cost

nodes.summary: Sankoff's cost is a lower bound for the cost of every labeling that agrees with the leaf states.
nodes.title: Sankoff's cost is a lower bound

nodes.summary: Sankoff's recursion at a leaf: cost `0` at the observed state, `⊤` elsewhere.
nodes.title: Sankoff's recursion at a leaf

nodes.summary: Sankoff's recursion at an internal vertex: the cost of state `s` is the sum, over the two children, of the minimum over the child's state `a` of the edge cost from `s` to `a` plus the child's cost at `a`.
nodes.title: Sankoff's recursion at an internal vertex

nodes.summary: The minimum cost of the subtree `t` given the state `s` at its root, computed by Felsenstein's pruning recursion over the tropical semiring.
nodes.title: Sankoff's algorithm

nodes.summary: The unit cost: `0` for no change and `1` for a change of state.
nodes.title: Unit substitution cost

nodes.summary: The weight of a labeling in the tropical semiring is its edge cost if it agrees with the leaf states and `⊤` otherwise.
nodes.title: Tropical weight of a labeling equals its edge cost

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
